description: This Java class defines the ResetConnectionMetricsStrategy, which handles ResetConnectionMetrics commands in the Eclipse Ditto connectivity messaging system. It extends an abstract strategy class and implements methods to generate responses and specify actions.

classes.name: ResetConnectionMetricsStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that processes ResetConnectionMetrics commands by generating appropriate responses and determining actions.

methods.name: getResponse
methods.description: Generates a response to a ResetConnectionMetrics command given the current connection state and headers.

methods.name: getActions
methods.description: Returns a list of actions to perform as part of this strategy, specifically broadcasting to client actors if started and sending a response.
